searchText: Adding the IL event fixed it, thanks! Should/does the EL enforce the `MAX_BYTES_PER_INCLUSION_LIST` limit when serving `engine_getInclusionListV1`? Yes it does: https://github.com/jihoonsong/go-ethereum/blob/focil/miner/inclusion_list_building.go#L40-L42 I noticed that Dora breaks when it reaches epoch 2 (happens with Teku and Prysm). I'm still running `jihoonsg/dora-focil:b6a120f`
